title: Logic Pattern Series
instructions: Discover the hidden geometric or numerical pattern in each sequence and choose the correct symbol that replaces the question mark.
description: Logic Pattern Series is an engaging spatial and mathematical puzzle game. Test your deductive reasoning, geometric intuition, and pattern recognition across multiple sequence challenges and daily logic brain teasers.

faqs.q: How do I play Logic Pattern Series?
faqs.a: Observe the progression of shapes, numbers, or matrices across cards 1 to 4. Find the transformation rule (such as adding sides, rotating 90°, multiplying by 2) and tap the option (A, B, C, or D) that logically fills the question mark.

faqs.q: Does the game work on mobile devices?
faqs.a: Yes! Logic Pattern Series is fully responsive and optimized for touch interactions on mobile phones, tablets, and desktop computers.
Each day features a unique logic sequence with bonus coins and daily streak tracking to sharpen your mind every day.
